notes: The spec budgets 5.2 GB; the real maxi file is 6.5 GiB and the 2026-06 edition was 7.8 GiB, so the Packs screen's size estimate needs updating. The file is over 2 GB and we do not host it, so the manifest's 'parts' splitting cannot apply -- the app has to manage one >2 GB download, and that is worth confirming on a real phone before this pack ships.
